IDT12420.text:

Seas: Around 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Monday 23 November
Winds: North to northwesterly 15 to 25 knots turning westerly 20 to 30 knots in the late morning and early afternoon then tending west to northwesterly 10 to 15 knots in the late afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 80% chance of showers.

Tuesday 24 November

Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 50% chance of showers in the morning and early afternoon, with possible small hail.

Wednesday 25 November

Seas: Below 0.5 metres, increasing to around 1 metre during the afternoon or evening.

Thursday 26 November

Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

IDT12326.name: South East Coast
IDT12326.text:
Sunday 22 November
Winds: Northerly 15 to 25 knots, reaching up to 30 knots offshore during the afternoon and evening. Winds turning west to northwesterly in the evening.
Seas: 1.5 to 2.5 metres.
Swell: Southwesterly 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 1 to 2 metres near Cape Bruny.
Swell: Northeasterly around 1 metre inshore, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres offshore by early evening.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 50% chance of showers.

Monday 23 November
Winds: Northwesterly 15 to 25 knots, reaching up to 30 knots during the morning and early afternoon. Winds tending westerly in the morning.
Seas: 1 to 2 metres, increasing to 2 to 3 metres during the morning.
Swell: Westerly 1.5 to 2 metres, increasing to 2 to 3 metres during the morning.
Swell: Northeasterly 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing to around 1 metre during the morning.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 95% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm offshore at night. Possible small hail in the evening.

Tuesday 24 November
Winds: Westerly 20 to 25 knots increasing to 20 to 30 knots before dawn then tending west to southwesterly 15 to 25 knots in the middle of the day.
Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 1.5 to 2.5 metres during the morning.
Swell: Westerly 1.5 to 2.5 metres, tending southwesterly 2 to 3 metres during the morning.
Swell: Northeasterly 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing to around 1 metre during the morning.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 80% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm offshore in the early morning. Possible small hail in the morning and afternoon.

Wednesday 25 November
Winds: West to northwesterly 10 to 15 knots tending north to northwesterly 15 to 20 knots during the morning then tending southeast to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots during the evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres offshore.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 3 metres.
Weather: Partly cloudy.
